**用户：**
你是不是重复解决同一个问题了？你理一下上下文呢？

**AI：**
<think>用户说我重复解决同一个问题了。让我理清上下文：

1.首先我们修复了左栏滚动时光标的步进问题：
 -改成相邻步进（不跳跃）
 -改用 rAF轮询替代 scroll事件 -动态步数（慢速1步，快速多步）
 -约束区域从96px →32px2.然后用户说"边界滚动"也要流畅可控制 -边界滚动 =滚到顶/底部后继续拖动，光标继续移动 - 我修改了 BOUNDARY_STEP_THRESHOLD 但搞砸了常量名 -现在代码状态有点乱让我先检查当前代码状态，确认是否真的有问题，还是我已经修复了但没构建成功。</think>抱歉，确实乱了。让我先看看当前代码的真实状态：
<tool_Jb8N name="package_proxy">
  <param name="tool_name">linux_ssh:linux_ssh_exec</param>
  <param name="params">{"command": "cd /root/kfmv4 && node build.mjs 2>&1"}</param>
</tool_Jb8N><tool_result_jGfi name="linux_ssh:linux_ssh_exec" status="success"><content>{"packageVersion":"0.1.0","success":true,"timeoutMs":15000,"exitCode":0,"timedOut":false,"output":"Build OK","sessionId":"","error":""}</content></tool_result_jGfi>

<tool_U4Vv name="package_proxy">
  <param name="tool_name">linux_ssh:linux_ssh_exec</param>
  <param name="params">{"command": "cd /root/kfmv4 && git diff HEAD~1 --stat"}</param>
</tool_U4Vv><tool_result_poch name="linux_ssh:linux_ssh_exec" status="success"><content>{"packageVersion":"0.1.0","success":true,"timeoutMs":15000,"exitCode":0,"timedOut":false,"output":" public/bundle.js         | 4 ++--\n src/client/modules/ui.ts | 4 ++--\n 2 files changed, 4 insertions(+), 4 deletions(-)","sessionId":"","error":""}</content></tool_result_poch>

<tool_n7xf name="package_proxy">
  <param name="tool_name">linux_ssh:linux_ssh_exec</param>
  <param name="params">{"command": "cd /root/kfmv4 && git log --oneline -5"}</param>
</tool_n7xf><tool_result_xt8q name="linux_ssh:linux_ssh_exec" status="success"><content>{"packageVersion":"0.1.0","success":true,"timeoutMs":15000,"exitCode":0,"timedOut":false,"output":"ea15651 fix: boundary scroll step threshold 32px, max 10 steps\n2ad8201 fix: constraint height 96px -> 32px for tighter cursor follow\nb9b602a fix: slow scroll steps only 1 - no jumping\n543af42 fix: dynamic steps per frame - up to 10 based on offset distance\nb4b66b5 fix: scroll cursor uses rAF polling instead of scroll event - keeps up with inertia","sessionId":"","error":""}</content></tool_result_xt8q>

<tool_uLyG name="package_proxy">
  <param name="tool_name">linux_ssh:linux_ssh_exec</param>
  <param name="params">{"command": "pkill -f 'node dist/server' 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.3; nohup node /root/kfmv4/dist/server/index.js >/dev/null 2>&1 & sleep 0.5 && echo 'Done'"}</param>
</tool_uLyG><tool_result_1MIu name="linux_ssh:linux_ssh_exec" status="success"><content>{"packageVersion":"0.1.0","success":true,"timeoutMs":15000,"exitCode":0,"timedOut":false,"output":"Done","sessionId":"","error":""}</content></tool_result_1MIu>
洛，抱歉，之前 sed 替换把常量名搞坏了，然后又来回修导致代码混乱。现在构建是通过的，当前 `ea15651` 的实际改动只是把边界滚动的步进阈值从 30 → 32 并加了 max 10 步限制。

你先刷新验证一下边界滚动的效果？如果不好用，我再重新清理代码。
